description: One-page invoice: header band, address blocks, a table with a footer row, page x of y
Two-page report: headings with bookmarks, justified paragraphs that split across pages, a link and its anchor
Short report with a two-page table of contents in roman numerals: levels, leaders, page numbers that follow the body's own numbering, a long title that wraps
A table over three pages: repeated header and footer, row and column spans, striped rows, collapsed borders
Bulleted, numbered, roman and lettered lists, a nested list and a custom marker
Borders (solid, dashed, dotted, per side), rounded corners, backgrounds, opacity, padding and nine-point alignment
Rotated, scaled and translated content, a watermark layer behind and over the page, and a canvas
JPEG and PNG pictures: contain, cover, stretch, fit width and height, and a PNG with alpha over a background
A right-to-left document: mirrored rows, start-aligned Arabic text, a mirrored list and table
Latin, Hebrew, Devanagari, Thai and Japanese text in one document, with font fallback
Spans in different weights, sizes, colours and decorations; superscripts; letter spacing; alignment; justification and indent
Two sections: roman-numbered front matter with a first-page header, then a landscape body numbered from 1
Gradient backgrounds: linear at several angles, radial, many stops, gray and CMYK, rounded and bordered, faded, rotated, in a table, and a box that splits over two pages
The same justified paragraphs set by first fit (left) and by Knuth-Plass total fit (right), with and without hyphenation
A newsletter page: a full-width title, a three-column article with a heading, a table, a picture and a rule between the columns, then a full-width note

A three-page account statement: brought forward in the header, carried forward and the page subtotal in the footer, the month of the first entry on the page in the header, amounts that follow their rows across page breaks
A paragraph with inline objects: drawn icons, a badge with its own text, pictures at every vertical alignment, a justified and a right-to-left line with objects, and a link on a picture

Colour glyphs from a COLR version 0 font built in code: layers in palette colours, the foreground layer taking the text colour, light and dark palettes, and a version 1 only glyph drawn as a plain box
